facts.text: Disk utilization was reported at 91% on lab-linux-01 at 2026-10-13T12:00:00Z.
Disk utilization changed from 75% to 91% over 6 hours (+16 percentage points).

forecast.summary: Next configured threshold: 95% (synthetic demo configuration). Observed growth: 2.67 percentage points/hour. Estimated time: 1.50 hours from the last sample (2026-10-13T12:00:00Z); projected crossing: 2026-10-13T13:30:00+00:00.
forecast.limitation: Linear scenario, not a guaranteed alert delivery time. Two points cannot establish normal background growth; longer history is required. No cleanup, capacity change or workload change is assumed.

hypotheses: Log growth is one possible cause, but no supporting log-size evidence is available. Data growth or insufficient filesystem capacity are alternatives.
missing_context: Directory growth and log sizes are unknown.
suggested_read_only_checks: Review disk utilization history in the existing monitoring tool.
Review mount capacity and inode utilization using read-only monitoring views.
Ask an authorized operator to inspect directory-size summaries without transmitting file contents.
Confirm service impact before selecting any remediation.
